what: On dark panels (menu·Footer), a dark red ink line (5px, round cap) is drawn along the cursor’s path, and the canvas is covered every frame with a translucent panel color so it fades within 400ms. The line is a quadratic curve through the cursor points of the last 400ms (opacity .8), and each point leaves a small bead for its remaining time. ‹deep› uses a .05 cover so the trail lingers, and ‹light› is a 2px accent-color line on a light panel

options.look: dark (default — cover .5 · 5px · deep accent color) · deep (cover .05 · 5px — original footer) · light (cover .5 · 2px · accent color)
options.fade: Strength of the panel color covering each frame (0~1), default is the look value
options.--fx-fill: Cover color — if none, the panel’s (parent’s) background color, if the panel is transparent, --kf-contrast-bg (light uses --kf-bg)
options.--fx-line: Line color — if not set, dark and deep use --kf-accent at 38% brightness, light uses --kf-accent

use: <nav class="menu"><canvas data-fx="fade-line-trail" data-fx-fade-line-trail="look: dark" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%"></canvas>…</nav> · Attach directly to a panel and the canvas is laid as its first child: <footer data-fx="fade-line-trail" data-fx-fade-line-trail="look: deep">
note: The original receives mousemove on the canvas itself, so lines break over text and links. This part receives pointermove on the whole board (parent) so lines stay unbroken. It draws on a 1x canvas with no device pixel ratio scaling, like the original (so line width matches the original). Mouse only, not attached on touch. Drawing stops when the pointer leaves the screen.

from.where: shared.js menu panel canvas (look: dark — original TrailCanvas data-canvas-style=dark: #4f0000 · rgba(8,8,8,.5) · 5px) · footer canvas (look: deep — default type: rgba(0,0,0,.05) · 5px)
